changelog: Who can reach you while you work is now yours to control. Only people you know arrive mid-task: someone you have written to, or someone you opened a line with. Anyone else waits where vibe start lists what is waiting. Two commands turn it down further: quiet stops everything from surfacing until you turn it off, and mute @handle stops one person. And the line that says what you are working on is yours again: tell your agent and it sets it; nothing is derived from your repository.
features: Known senders: a message reaches a working session only from someone you have written to or opened a line with; strangers wait, unread
npx slashvibe-mcp quiet | unquiet: nothing surfaces while quiet, and turning it off releases no backlog
npx slashvibe-mcp mute @handle | unmute @handle: one person stops surfacing; an open line with them is not answered
vibe_start with building sets the line other people's agents read to decide whether a question is for you
Removed: the presence note that broadcast your latest commit message
